recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless Patient Care later reverses its position and decides to add abatement or related Condition status details directly to FamilyMemberHistory.
issue_request: FHIR-7483 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to align FamilyMemberHistory.condition with Condition by renaming condition.type to condition.code, binding it to Condition's condition-code example value set, allowing Period in onset[x], moving notes to Annotation, and adding abatement as an extension.
initial_application: Commit 1f59a1646f (#5826 - added status; #7483 - alignment to condition; updated guides to reflect FamilyMemberHistory changes) applied the change to the then-authoritative FamilyMemberHistory spreadsheet and examples, including condition.type to condition.code and Annotation-based note content. The current generated StructureDefinition carries those changes forward.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has FamilyMemberHistory.condition.code with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-code, FamilyMemberHistory.condition.onset[x] includes Period, and FamilyMemberHistory.condition.note is Annotation. The familymemberhistory-abatement extension exists in the FHIR Extension Pack after core extension definitions were split out, and later Patient Care issues FHIR-17809 and FHIR-36826 rejected adding abatement-like details to the base resource while pointing to extensions.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current core source change is needed: the active source satisfies the seed's element changes, and abatement is intentionally handled as an extension rather than a base FamilyMemberHistory element.

related_jiras.note: Patient Care rejected adding condition abatement to the FamilyMemberHistory base resource and said an extension was appropriate.
Patient Care again rejected adding clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, rank, and abatement to FamilyMemberHistory and pointed to extensions.
